senses.gloss:
mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Occasional.
n. (-कं)
Occasional, periodical act or rite.
E.
निमित्त cause, ठक् aff.

n. (-र्म्म)
An occasional ceremony, such as should be observed on the birth of a child, &c.
E.
नैमित्तिक, and कर्म्भ act; also नैमित्तिकक्रिया, &c.

mfn. (-षः-षी-षं)
Momentary, transient, in a twinkling.
n. (-षं)
The name of a forest. see नैमिषारण्य.
E.
निमिष, and अण् aff.

n. (-ण्यं)
A wood celebrated as the residence of the Ṛṣis, to whom Sauti related the Mahābhārata.
E.
निमिष a twinkling of an eye, in which the sage GAURAMUKHA destroyed a sort of Asuras, and अण् aff. and अरण्य forest.

m. (-यः)
Barter, exchange.
E.
नि before मि to measure, अच् aff. and अण् added.
